name: Skilled Job Seeker visa (Visto de Procura de Trabalho Qualificado)

requirements.blocker_text: This is restricted to holders of specialized technical or highly-qualified skills under Article 57-A of Lei n.º 61/2025 — the exact qualifying criteria are set by an implementing Portaria that has not yet been published.

sources.title: Diário da República — Lei n.º 61/2025 (Lei de Estrangeiros), Article 57-A

notes: GENUINELY NEW CASE TYPE for this dataset, not previously encountered across UK, Germany, or Netherlands: this route exists IN LAW (Article 57-A of Lei n.º 61/2025, in force since 23 October 2025) but is NOT OPERATIONALLY AVAILABLE — the implementing Portaria (joint ministerial regulation) that would define the actual qualifying criteria, application process, and fees has not been published as of this verification date. No consulate or visa application centre (VFS Global, BLS, TLScontact) currently accepts applications under this article. This is distinct from every other 'draft' route encoded so far in this dataset, which were draft due to incomplete SOURCING on Mapply's end — here, the sourcing is complete and tier-1, but the underlying REAL-WORLD PROCESS doesn't exist yet. Marked 'draft' as the closest fit in the current status enum, but this is arguably a genuine schema gap worth a future 'status: enacted_not_operational' value distinct from both 'draft' (data incomplete) and 'closed' (route ended) — flagged here rather than silently forcing this into either existing bucket. The old general job-seeker visa (120 days + 60-day extension, no skills restriction) that this replaced was closed to new applications from 23 October 2025 — so there is currently NO functioning job-seeker visa of any kind for Portugal, a real and consequential gap in the country's route offerings worth surfacing prominently rather than burying in a note. Re-verify against diariodarepublica.pt and vistos.mne.gov.pt for the Portaria's eventual publication.
